name: kairos-orbit
description: Public framework and reference scorer for KAIROS-ORBIT operator AI fluency analysis.

scripts.check: npm run build && node dist/cli.js score examples/synthetic-chat.jsonl > /tmp/kairos-orbit-smoke.json && node dist/cli.js report examples/synthetic-chat.jsonl --output /tmp/kairos-orbit-report.md && node scripts/collect-lite-input.mjs --roots examples --out /tmp/kairos-orbit-collected.jsonl && node dist/cli.js report /tmp/kairos-orbit-collected.jsonl --output /tmp/kairos-orbit-collected-report.md
